blocks.text: This test build uses separate wallet storage, starts on testnet on first launch, and does not check for or install updates. Install subsequent test builds manually.

items: Delegate ordinary coins with a dedicated ECDSA or Falcon owner key. Registration is submitted through the blockchain, without a separate service API.
Track staking balances and operations. Unstake a chosen amount or use Max; the remainder stays delegated. Send spends only ordinary coins.
Recover uncertain submissions with explicit recovery transfers and continue observing conflicts after chain reorganizations.
Deposits start at 0.001 coins on mainnet and testnet, subject to service acceptance.
The published chain SDK supports transactions up to 2 MiB. Larger staking maximum transfers are split into separately reviewed parts.
